fusions.name: Rolling Slam
fusions.desc: You roll into the target for a blow that deals 14 damage, leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Loose Barbs
fusions.desc: Flings out loose barbs, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Rolled Tight
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Overlapping Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6, and your armour is 6% higher. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (46% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
